messages:
Avery Chen: Thanks all — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Capturing the Q&A we didn't get to + owners/links. I'll keep this short.

Maya Patel: Quick question on GA timing — we heard Q3, can we be more specific?

Samir Nair: Tentative GA quarter is Q3; target milestone is feature-complete + SLOs met. Working doc here: https://redwood.example.com/roadmaps/dedicated-ga (WIP).

Priya Rao: I'll own the evaluation prompt suite. Plan: curated prompts + stress cases. Target draft by 2026-04-15. @Samir Nair can you confirm sampling policy? :spiral_calendar:

Diego Morales: Ops will produce the Dedicated runbook (capacity model, failover, incident play). I'll post a draft in #eng-ops by EOD tomorrow.

Avery Chen: Action list so far: Maya -> finalize GA criteria doc; Priya -> prompt set; Samir -> SLO/tests + sampling policy; Diego -> runbook. Please add yourself to the tracker and set due dates. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/REDWOOD-AH-ACTIONS

Maya Patel: Clarify pricing: will burst/auto-scale be part of the core GA offering or an add-on? Need this for go-to-market message.

Samir Nair: Short answer: burst is an opt-in add-on for GA. Core reserved capacity is fixed commit. We'll add explicit language to the pricing doc by next week.

Priya Rao: For evals, recommend stable samplings with a default temp of 0.7 for regression checks, plus deterministic seeds for exact-replay tests. Thoughts?

Samir Nair: Agreed on dual-mode evals (stochastic + deterministic). I'll confirm the sampling policy by EOD Wed and update the SLO tests.

AH Bot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/recordings/3580009876 — transcript ready.

Diego Morales: From Q&A flagged two infra items: 1) multi-tenant cache invalidation patterns, 2) KV eviction policy tuning for long-context workloads. I'll raise tickets and link here.

Samir Nair: Tickets created: RH-2143 (cache invalidation), RH-2144 (KV eviction tuning). Briefs posted in #eng-runtime.

Maya Patel: I'll schedule a 30m cross-functional sync (product + sales + docs) to align messaging for GA. Proposed: Tue 10am PT. Is that working for people?

Avery Chen: Tue 10am PT works for me — I'll invite the sales leads and product marketing.

Priya Rao: Support asked for a one-pager on Private deployment network requirements. I'll draft and share in #support by next Friday.

Avery Chen: Perfect. If you volunteered during the AH, please add your name to the action tracker and include an expected due date. We need owners to be explicit. :white_check_mark:

Samir Nair: ACK — will update SLO doc and sampling policy.

Diego Morales: ACK :thumbsup: — runbook draft will be up tomorrow.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — I'll push the GA criteria doc link once it's stable and ping this thread with the calendar invite.

Avery Chen: Thanks — short, practical follow-ups. If anything else comes up, reply here and I'll triage.
